LanguageData.CC_Reason_HotFreezer: {PAWN_nameDef} watches the food turn in the heat, and nothing in the colony keeps it cold.
LanguageData.CC_Reason_SeasonWarm: What {PAWN_nameDef} wears keeps {PAWN_objective} comfortable down to {COMFY}, and {SEASON} will bring days around {TEMP}.
LanguageData.CC_Reason_SeasonCool: What {PAWN_nameDef} wears keeps {PAWN_objective} comfortable up to {COMFY}, and {SEASON} will bring afternoons around {TEMP}.
LanguageData.CC_Promise_SeasonClothes: {FOR_nameDef} goes to the stores to put on the {ITEM}.
LanguageData.CC_Reason_SaunaCold: {PAWN_nameDef} is cold to the bone and dreams of a hot sauna.
LanguageData.CC_Reason_Sauna: The winter here is long, and {PAWN_nameDef} would like somewhere hot to sit at the end of a cold day.
LanguageData.CC_Fulfilled_SaunaModded: The colony has a sauna: {THING} in a small closed room, or another sauna heater.
LanguageData.CC_Fulfilled_SaunaOwn: The colony has a sauna: a small closed room (30 cells at most, no bed or workbench in it) with a seat and {THING} or another heat source, kept at {HEAT} or more. A fire can only warm a room so far: with only a fire, as warm as it can make it does.
LanguageData.CC_Kept_Lost_Sauna: The sauna {FOR_nameDef} asked for is gone.
LanguageData.CC_Reason_FishingIdle: There's a fishing spot marked out by the water, and nobody goes near it. {PAWN_nameDef} would.
LanguageData.CC_Reason_Favourite: {PAWN_nameDef} has always loved {KINDS}, and they live on this land.
LanguageData.CC_Reason_FavouriteHere: {PAWN_nameDef} has always loved {KINDS}, and there's one out on the land right now.
LanguageData.CC_PW_Reason_Favourite: {KIND} has always been {PAWN_nameDef}'s favourite Pokémon, and they live round here.
LanguageData.CC_PW_Reason_FavouriteHere: {KIND} has always been {PAWN_nameDef}'s favourite Pokémon, and there's a wild one out there now.
LanguageData.CC_Promise_FavouriteTame: The council marks {OTHER_definite} for taming, for {FOR_nameDef}'s sake.
LanguageData.CC_SelfHelp_Favourite: {PAWN_nameDef} picked out {OTHER_definite} and marked it for taming. If {PAWN_pronoun} isn't allowed to handle animals, someone else will have to.
LanguageData.CC_Favourite_Bonded: {ANIMAL_nameDef} has bonded with {PAWN_nameDef}: the very kind {PAWN_pronoun} always loved, and it chose {PAWN_objective}.
LanguageData.CC_Reason_PackHauler: {PAWN_nameDef} hauls more than anyone here, and {KIND} could carry the load.
LanguageData.CC_Reason_PackTrader: {PAWN_nameDef} has a trader's tongue and nothing to carry the goods: {KIND} would do.
LanguageData.CC_Reason_PackRoads: {PAWN_nameDef} would rather be on the road, and {KIND} of {PAWN_possessive} own would make it easier.
LanguageData.CC_Planting_AllSown: The fields are all in: every row sown on the planting day.
LanguageData.CC_Planting_Chronicle: The fields were all sown on the planting day.
LanguageData.CC_Planting_GoodStart: The crop sown on the planting day stands ripe, row after row. The growers call it a good start.
LanguageData.CC_Planting_WordsLabel: a word at the field's edge
LanguageData.CC_Cal_Way_Planting_Desc: the colony sows the fields together and its grower says a few words at the field's edge in the evening (with nothing to sow, a walk out to the fields); hope and a little practice, no mood.
LanguageData.CC_Cal_Way_Planting_Letter: If the council keeps it, everyone who can be spared goes out to the fields with the seed, and the grower says a few words at the edge when it's done.
